title: NBFC for Sale in Delhi, India
tagline: Delhi-based RBI-approved NBFC engaged in providing finance and loan products and investment-related services. - The company has a reported net worth of more than INR 10 crore and has been operating since 16 years. - The business currently has 5 employees and operates from a rented office. - The business is being offered for full sale, with further details available to qualified buyers during due diligence. - The company has an Incorporation Certificate and RBI license. - The 5 employees are required to manage loan operations, customer support, compliance, finance, and day-to-day NBFC activities.
